_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F12, Pip again (comic): a 99% accurate map.

text.zh_TW: 皮普從柱子後面探出頭：「客人！書庫的地圖，準確度高達百分之九十九！只要五枚金幣！」
text.en: Pip pops out from behind a pillar. "Customer! A map of the library, ninety-nine percent accurate! Only five gold!"

text.zh_TW: 皮普：「……出口就是入口。小事！」他還是塞了一瓶藥水給你。「算了，這次送你。投資要照顧。」
text.en: Pip: "...The exit is the entrance. A detail!" He presses a potion into your hands anyway. "Fine, this one's free. A good investor looks after his investment."
